messages.subject: tRophicPosition
messages.body_plain:
Greetings,

I hope this email finds you well. I am hoping to get into contact with the developer of the R package tRophicPosition.

I am Master's student at Penn State, hoping to try and use tRophicPosition for a project, but found it had been removed from the CRAN repository. Are there any coming updates, or is the package no longer available?

Thank you for your help.

Cheers,

Olivia

messages.subject: Re: [tRophicPosition-support] tRophicPosition
messages.body_plain:
Hi Olivia

The GitHub version should be easy to install with

install.packages("githubinstall")
githubinstall::gh_install_packages("tRophicPosition", ref = "stanCSIA")

If you can't have it working, just let me know.

Cheers

Claudio
